protocol: Six clustered C procbench rounds, grouped command runs, all six role permutations; ordinary shared lock separately per round, CPU2, normal ASLR. External procbench counters include kernel+user, positive without multiplexing marker, no raw enabled/running times. Backend inner counters exclude kernel/hypervisor and retain no enabled/running times. Wall release-to-wait4 differs from time-runs; resource usage includes child setup. Even medians use the midpoint of the central pair; each round main reference is midpoint of A1/A2 medians. Six clusters are not 1584 independent image comparisons. A/A spread is evidence, not an approval or an acceptance limit. Printed backend precision and single large-ASM process per role remain limitations.
